reviews.author: Tammie Slaughter
reviews.text: We have used Locklear's plumbing on two occasions and have been extremely pleased with his work. He located and repaired a leak that was under our house, replaced some shower drains and also replaced 2 toilets. He is easy to communicate with, professional and very reasonably priced. Highly recommend!! Update: We have now hired Locklear's Plumbing for various jobs, both large and small, and we couldn’t be more satisfied. We highly recommend his services to anyone in need of quality plumbing work!

reviews.author: Shakelah Locklear
reviews.text: Brandon is a top of the line plumber who is dedicated and ensures that the job is done correctly. He was able to fix the plumbing in my house and was very professional. He ensured that he provided work in a cost effective manner and was there to address any questions on concerns I had! You can not go wrong with Locklear’s Plumbing!

reviews.author: Hailey Bell
reviews.text: One of the best service’s you gonna get around Robeson country. If you need a plumber then this is the handy man for you. He did work at the house and my family was satisfied.
